mutations.name: splash-arming-guard
mutations.seeds: every Appeared arms a new safety net; a splash that reappears fires twice

mutations.name: root-splash-hold
mutations.seeds: the session's first report moves the phase while the splash is still on screen

mutations.name: root-late-signin-guard
mutations.seeds: a sign-in completion that arrives after the gate is gone re-enters a phase and replaces the session
